تكترون (form VIII)
# تَكْتَرُونَ (taktarūna) /tak.ta.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَرَى (iktarā)
# تُكْتَرَوْنَ (tuktarawna) /tuk.ta.raw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَرَى (iktarā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
